meta.title: Find running stacks and routes in the browser: proposed

frontend.label: UI step where the work started

nodes.label: Follow All Stacks link
nodes.explanation: Every surface that knows about stacks leads to the directory, because devhost never opens a browser: All Stacks on This Machine ends the toolbar's stack name menu after a separator, and the Caddy 404, stack-run-stop's stopped-stack page and the status pages carry the same link; devhost start prints 'All stacks on this machine: https://devhost.localhost/' after its ready line, and devhost stack list and devhost status print it too (stack-run-stop's slice). Every link and printed URL is the directory's current address from the applied shared Caddy settings, with the port when httpsPort is not 443, so a directory proxy-settings moved is never linked at its old address (proxy-settings-04, owned by proxy-settings). Links open in the same tab (SURF-15, MENU-1, MENU-2, WORD-2). While the local certificate authority is untrusted, first-run-setup's trust line leads the page (first-run-setup-02, owned by first-run-setup). Resolves stack-directory-06's slice: the toolbar and the Caddy 404 link to the directory.

sources.label: Replaces: start prints only service URLs
Replaces: stack list prints PID and path

nodes.label: Stacks on this machine
nodes.explanation: GET / on the directory hostname opens the page: the heading 'Stacks on this machine', the totals '3 stacks · 1 failed · 1 with an agent waiting for you · 2 stopped recently' and a document title that starts with what needs the person (ACT-6, WORD-5, O16). Cards sit in one column in 'Needs you', 'Running' and 'Stopped recently', each headed with its count; within a group stacks sort by name, then the main checkout before its worktrees, so two checkouts of one project sit together and read apart: 'Acme Shop · main ~/acme', 'Acme Shop · fix-nav ~/acme/.worktrees/fix-nav' (SEL-4, SEL-6). A serve session reads 'Serve session' with its folder or port (WORD-1). One line says once that the page is read-only and updates every 2 s (MENU-3, MENU-6, O10). With nothing running and nothing stopped recently: 'No stacks are running on this machine. Start one with devhost start in its folder.' (STATE-2). Keys: the document's own; the filter and Refresh Stacks are the first Tab stops (KEY-1, KEY-10). Resolves stack-directory-03 and the totals of stack-directory-02.

sources.label: Replaces: totals of stacks and URLs only
Replaces: title is the stack name; path; PID

nodes.label: Filter as you type
nodes.explanation: The field 'Filter stacks and services' narrows the cards as the person types, with no form and no reload; it matches stack name, checkout label, service names and hostnames, never a manifest file's or the devhost config file's path (SEL-10, KEY-9). A stack whose name or checkout matches keeps every row; another keeps only its matching rows with '4 more services hidden by the filter'; the match is highlighted and each group header counts what it shows (SEL-10, BAR-3, WORD-5). No match reads 'No stack or service matches "serch"' with Clear Filter (STATE-2). The query stays in the address as ?q=. Escape clears the field; Enter does nothing more (KEY-9). Refresh Stacks is a button of its own that reads every stack at once and keeps focus while busy (FB-1, KEY-11). Resolves the filter and refresh half of stack-directory-07.

sources.label: Replaces: GET form; Refresh / filter button
Replaces: any match keeps the whole stack

nodes.label: Read a stack's card
nodes.explanation: Every word on a card comes from the state the stack's services runtime publishes, the one the toolbar and devhost status read, drawn with services-panel's shared state indicator (ACT-2, ACT-13, SURF-14). The header names the stack, its checkout label and its state: 'failed · 4 of 6 running · 1 exited · 1 not started' (ACT-6, SEL-4). Rows give the cause and time: 'exited with code 3 at 17:15' with its last output line, 'failed its health check · since 17:14', 'blocked', 'not started · left out of this run', 'not reachable · checked 17:15:02' (FAIL-3, WORD-8). Each state's lead action is one step away: a link to the service's status page and the same action's terminal command with Copy, since the directory stays read-only (MENU-5, MENU-6, O10; this flow's proposed MENU-5 exception). Conditions say once what needs the person, a waiting agent is a link to its decision card, and the last outcome matches devhost status (ACT-7, REV-9, FB-11). Resolves stack-directory-02, with stack-directory-08 and stack-directory-09 on the rows.

sources.label: Replaces: green only for Running, gray rest

nodes.label: Configuration applied?
nodes.explanation: Configuration · 2 files expands the stack's manifest files, named by kind: 'Root manifest · devhost.toml'. Each says whether the stack runs it: 'Applied 17:03', or 'Not applied · rejected at 17:12 · line 42: expected ]' with 'the stack runs the accepted manifest' (UNDO-6, HOLD-6, MENU-4). A file that was not applied opens on 'Running version' with 'Version on disk' beside it and the rejected line marked; files show line numbers. Open in Editor hands the file and line to the stack's editor through component-source's hand-off, and Copy copies 'devhost.toml:42'; from another machine Open in Editor is unavailable with its reason (MENU-3, HOLD-1). The devhost config file is listed once, at the foot of the page (WORD-1). The caveat printed on every card today goes. Resolves stack-directory-05.

sources.label: Replaces: files read from disk only
Replaces: collapsible files, fixed caveat

nodes.label: Published state, live
nodes.explanation: While the page is visible it reads GET /stacks.json on the directory hostname 2 s after the previous read ended, and reads nothing while hidden (ACT-12). A live stack's control server answers with every stack's snapshot, each asked in parallel with a 2 s deadline over loopback, under the same local-only, GET-only guard as / (Backend 5). Each snapshot carries the published service state (CC-25): cause, since when, health and external checks, blocked repositories, changed files; no state defaults to running, and the runtime runs every health check while the directory reads (Backend 1). Updates move cards, totals and the title in place, never focus, and the announcer says once each change that starts or ends a need (FB-9, KEY-6). With no stack running, Caddy serves static stacks.json and stacks.html with the stopped-stack records (CC-27). Resolves stack-directory-09, the live half of stack-directory-07 and stack-directory-08's published blocked state.

sources.label: Reuses: fan-out with a 2 s deadline per stack
Replaces: one status word, Running default

nodes.label: Check Again
nodes.explanation: A blocked repository's condition line and a service that is not reachable offer Check Again: GET /stacks.json?check=<stack> asks that stack to run its external checks and read its checkout list now, which stops nothing and starts no operation (HOLD-1, HOLD-4, ACT-9; Backend 10, still to be settled). The button keeps focus while busy, 'Checking search…', and its result replaces the row's state and time (KEY-11, FB-9). Blocked services read blocked, never starting or running, under 'The saved checkout ~/acme/.workspaces/ui-polish was deleted; devhost started none of its 6 services', said once with the way back on the status page. Read from another machine, Check Again is unavailable with 'Check Again works only on this machine' beside it (MENU-3). Resolves stack-directory-08; carries stack-directory-09's external checks.

nodes.label: Mistyped hostname
nodes.explanation: A hostname that no live stack routes, mistyped or from a stale bookmark, reaches Caddy's fallback site, as today.

sources.label: Reuses: fallback answers unrouted hosts

nodes.label: Did you mean …?
nodes.explanation: A page load of an unrouted hostname gets devhost's own page with status 404, leading with what was asked for: 'No devhost route for hotfix-shpo.shop.localhost/checkout', before the status code in reading order (SURF-16, FB-9, WORD-7). Its lead action is the close hostname with the path and query kept, 'Did you mean hotfix-shop.shop.localhost/checkout?', within two edits, at most three, closest first (a threshold for the product owner), then All Stacks on This Machine (MENU-5, SEL-10, SURF-15). 'Hostnames on this machine' groups every routed hostname by stack and checkout with its service and draws no state, since the page changes only when routes do (ACT-12). A request that is not a page load gets 404 with a body under 2 KB, the answer startup-and-recovery asked for (agent-cli-journey-04, owned by startup-and-recovery). A hostname whose stack stopped recently gets stack-run-stop's page instead (stack-run-stop-11). Resolves stack-directory-04 and the 404's link of stack-directory-06.

sources.label: Replaces: route list A to Z, no stack
Replaces: active hostnames as bare links
Replaces: 404 title and Caddy wording

nodes.label: Service page opens
nodes.explanation: A route link opens, in the same tab, the app when its service runs, or devhost's status page for a service that is not running, which leads with that cause's action (Restart, Start, the way back to a checkout); the link says so: 'https://reports.shop.localhost/ · status page' (SURF-15, MENU-5). An agent waiting for the person opens its stack's page with docked chat on the decision card in one activation (REV-9, ACT-6). This is the journey's outcome in place: the person reaches the page they chose. There is no Undo: the directory writes nothing, so nothing needs undoing and no rollback applies (UNDO-1); the browser's Back returns to the directory, which keeps its ?q= filter.

sources.label: Reuses: service URLs as same-tab links

nodes.label: Stopped recently
nodes.explanation: A stack that stopped within O15's 24 hours keeps a card in 'Stopped recently', read from stack-run-stop's stopped-stack record, with when and why it stopped, 'stopped at 02:14 after 30 min without requests (idleTimeout)' or 'killed at 09:02; its devhost process ended without cleaning up', and devhost start in its folder with Copy (ACT-10, STATE-2, STATE-3, UNDO-5, CC-27). A killed stack names each service it left running, 'api still runs from the killed stack (PID 8123, port 4001)', with devhost stop in its folder (ACT-11). An open page moves a stack that stops here within 4 s and says so once (FB-9). With nothing running, Caddy's static page lists these too. Resolves the empty state of stack-directory-07, which forgot what stopped; reads the record of stack-run-stop-11 (owned by stack-run-stop).

sources.label: Replaces: static empty directory page
Replaces: empty-state copy

nodes.label: No stack answers
nodes.explanation: When no stack answers within 2 s, after a crash or a kill from outside devhost or with every stack's devhost paused, a page load still gets devhost's directory page, with status 503: Caddy's error handler serves the static page devhost last wrote, listing the stacks registered then, each drawn unknown, 'unknown · did not answer within 2 s · last seen 17:03 · PID 4121', never stopped, with 'If its devhost process is paused, run fg in its terminal' and devhost start and devhost stop in its folder with Copy, under 'Not updated since 17:03: no running stack answered within 2 s · retrying every 2 s' (STATE-4, STATE-3, ACT-5, FAIL-2, O16). It retries every 2 s while visible, Refresh Stacks asks at once, and the live directory returns in place, announced once (ACT-12, FB-9, KEY-11). A request that is not a page load gets one short 503 line (FB-11). A stack record devhost cannot read is named in one condition line, with Copy Error holding Go's error and its path, while every readable stack stays listed (FAIL-2, WORD-7). Resolves stack-directory-10.

sources.label: Replaces: handle_errors plain-text 503
Replaces: record error as plain 503
Replaces: one bad record fails the list

nodes.label: A stack does not answer
nodes.explanation: When one stack's devhost process does not answer, paused by Ctrl-Z in its terminal, kill -STOP or a debugger, it never holds the page: Caddy's health checks, every 2 s with a 1 s timeout, skip it within about 3 s and another running stack serves the directory; a load that reached it before a check moves on after a 4 s response timeout, longer than the 2 s per-stack wait, so a healthy stack waiting on it is never cut off (Backend 12 (e)). Its card keeps its last known rows drawn as unknown, 'unknown · did not answer within 2 s · last seen 17:15:02', never stopped or failed, with 'Its devhost process (PID 4121) is running but did not answer within 2 s. If you pressed Ctrl-Z in its terminal, run fg there; a debugger may also have paused it.' and Copy Error holding Go's original error; the totals count it, '1 unknown' (ACT-5, STATE-3, STATE-4, WORD-6, FAIL-2, MENU-5). After fg, the next passing check and read draw it live again, announced once (ACT-12, FB-9). Resolves stack-directory-11.

cards.title: What changes versus today
items: Removed: the combined Refresh / filter button and the form that reloaded the page through every stack; server-side filtering on file paths; Show all stacks; the URL count; the caveat on every card; the raw UTC Registered time and the folder under every row; Running as a default and one gray badge for six states; Active hostnames and Caddy's wording on the 404; the plain-text 503 and Go's raw record error; Go's raw error on a silent stack's card

Merged: the directory's status words and the toolbar's become one published state drawn by one shared indicator, in the words devhost status prints; Clear filter and Show all stacks become Clear Filter

New: checkout labels; Needs you, Running and Stopped recently; the title's attention prefix; updates every 2 s; filtering as you type; Refresh Stacks; causes and times on rows; lead actions as links and commands with Copy; Check Again; waiting agents as links; applied or not applied with both versions; the 404's asked-for hostname and close match with the path kept; the 503 page listing the stacks devhost last knew; short answers for requests that are not page loads; health checks that hand the page to another stack when one does not answer, its card unknown with how to resume it

Changed: statuses update while the page is open and stopped stacks stay listed for 24 hours (CC-27); the filter keeps only matching rows; one unreadable stack record no longer hides the other stacks; a paused stack no longer holds the page

Kept: one page for every stack on the machine, any live stack serving it with a 2 s deadline per stack; local clients only unless stackDirectoryAllowRemote, GET and HEAD only, loopback snapshots, no-store and no-referrer; the reserved hostname; read-only, no writes and no browser opened; same-tab links; ?q= links; devhost start still refuses while a stack record cannot be read

cards.title: Tickets this journey resolves
items: Links to the directory: stack-directory-06 (the toolbar and Caddy 404 slice; the printed URLs: stack-run-stop)
Page, groups and checkout labels: stack-directory-03
Cards, states and lead actions: stack-directory-02, stack-directory-08, stack-directory-09
Filter, Refresh Stacks, live updates and Stopped recently: stack-directory-07
Configuration applied or not: stack-directory-05
Caddy 404: stack-directory-04
No stack answers, unreadable stack records: stack-directory-10
A stack that does not answer: stack-directory-11

Related, not covered: agent-cli-journey-04 (startup-and-recovery); error-pages-01 with stack-directory-01 (its stopgap ships first); first-run-setup-02 (first-run-setup); proxy-settings-04 (proxy-settings, stack-run-stop, manifest-hot-reload); stack-run-stop-11 (stack-run-stop)

cards.title: Backend work
items: The snapshot reads the published service state (services-panel's); no state is a default; health, daemon and external checks run while the directory reads
Stack fields: state and summary, checkout labels, foreground or detached, start time, last outcome, blocked reasons, serve session names
[discuss] Waiting agents with a link to their decision card (agent-chat's route)
Configuration state: applied or not applied, the structured rejection, the accepted text while it differs
GET /stacks.json beside /, under the same guard; static stacks.json and stacks.html with stopped-stack records and the registered stacks
The filter moves to the page; order by need, then name, main checkout first
[discuss] The 404 embeds routes by stack and checkout; a short 404 for requests that are not page loads
The directory's URL for the toolbar and the status pages; Open in Editor through component-source's hand-off
[discuss] Check Again: GET /stacks.json?check=<stack>, this machine only
handle_errors serves the static page and data with 503, one short line otherwise; a reader that names unreadable stack records; the re-render after a dead devhost drops its control port
Health checks on the proxy hop, a response timeout longer than the 2 s per-stack wait and a retry count, so another stack serves the page; a silent stack reported unknown with its PID

cards.title: Contract changes
items: CC-27: stopped stacks stay listed with when, why and the start command; cards count running services and update while the page is open
Read, unchanged here: CC-25 (published service state), CC-38 (sessions across checkouts), CC-39 (the person's editor), CC-11 (devhost service commands)

[discuss]: stack-lifecycle.md's counts, Configuration, Refresh / filter, Clear filter, serving and unavailable-page sentences and managed-caddy.md's 404 sentence need CC-n entries beside CC-27 and CC-31
